spans.s:
n. (-वं)
A water lily, a lotus.

n. (-ङ्गः)
Lead.
E.
कु bad, and वङ्ग tin.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Abusive, censorious, detracting.
E.
कु bad, वच to speak, क aff.

n. (-कं)
Crystal, a stone resembling a diamond.
E.
कु inferior, वज्र the diamond, कन् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Censorious.
E.
कु bad, वद to speak, क aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Detracting, censorious.
E.
कु evil, वद to speak, अण् aff.

m. (-रः)
An astringent taste: see तुवर.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing.
mn. (-रः-रं)
The pole of a carriage or wood to which the yoke is fixed.
m. (-रः)
A humpbacked man.
f. (-री)
A carriage covered with a cloth or blanket.
E.
कू to sound, and वर from वृ to cherish, with अप् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
1 The jujube, the tree.
2 The fruit.
n. (-लं)
1 A water lily.
2 A pearl.
E.
कु the earth, and वल to cover, affix अच्; see the next.

n. (-यः)
1 Any water lily.
2 The blue lotus.
E.
कु the earth, वल to cover, and कयन् affix; also कुवल, and कुव.

f. (-नी)
A place abounding in water lilies.
E.
कुवलय, and इनि aff.

m. (-श्वः)
A proper name of a king; also घुन्धुमार.

m. (-लः)
A camel.

m. (-न्दः)
A weaver.
E.
कुप to spread, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix, and प changed to व; also कुपिन्द.

m. (-हः)
A degrading or improper marriage.
E.
कु, and विवाह marriage.

m. (-कृत्)
A plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella): see पूतिक.

f. (-णी)
1 A fish basket.
2 An ill braided tress of hair.
3 A woman with her hair ill braided.
E.
कु bad, वेण to go, घञ् affix, and ङीष् fem. affix; also with टाप् or इन् affixed, कुवेणा and कुवेणि.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Deformed, monstrous.
2 Slow, lazy.
m. (-रः)
KUVERA the son of VISRAVAS by IḌAVIḌĀ, the chief of the Yakṣas, god of wealth and regent of the north.
E.
कु vile, and वेर body, alluding to the deformity of the god, who is represented as having three legs and but eight teeth.
2 The Tūn tree: see नन्दिवृक्ष.
3 One of the attendants of a Jaina saint.
E.
as above, or कुवि to cover, &c. and एरच् Uṇādi affix; in this case the word may be read कुबेर.

m. (-कः)
The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-क्षी)
The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
कुवेर, and अक्षि the eye.

m. (-लः)
Mount Kailāsa.
E.
कुवेर, and अचल a mountain; the capital of KUVERA, being situated in Kailāsa, which is supposed to be in the Himālaya range.

m. (-द्रिः)
See the preceding.
E.
as above, अद्रि being a mountain.

n. (-लं)
Any water lily.
E.
कु the earth, बेल to shake, अच् affix: see कुवलय.

n. (-व्रं)
A forest or wood.

m. (-री)
A carriage.
E.
कूवर the pole, इनि
